3100000000: "After completing the guardian quest,\nyou can summon a guardian of your profession when the guardian gage on your character information window is full.\nSummon and check out your guardian's awesome powers."
3100000001: Combat profession acquires Skill points whenever leveling up.\nAcquire the talent you want by opening the talent window (Hotkey T).
3100000002: "When creating a character,\nyou can create special items according to your selected profession.\nOpen the creation window (Hotkey J)to check out the items you can create."
3100000003: You can switch to a simple map by pressing the shrink button on the upper right side of the world map.\nYou can open the world map menu by pressing the Ctrl key while on the simple map.\nYou can also move the location of the map by dragging the window.
3100000004: Equipment used wll decrease in endurance when engaging in combat or dying.\nThe equipment cannot be used once endurance reaches 0.\nFrequently check the endurance level and go to the village repair expert for repair whenever needed.
3100000005: You can see a list of quests accepted in your quest information window (Hotkey L).\nQuests are registered to the quest notification system when the box is checked next to the quest title.
3100000006: You can purchase profession-related items through profession expert NPCs at any village or city.
3100000007: You can use auto-run by using the mouse wheel or pressing the Num Lock key.
3100000008: You can receive Profession Change quests from Profession Change Officer NPCs at Prontera once you reach combat profession level 25.
3100000009: "You can use your current location as a returning point through Kafra Service's Location Save Menu at any village or base where they are present.\nYou will return to the saved returning point upon resurrection after death or when using Butterfly's Wing, purchased through Kafra Services."
3100000010: Each profession uses a unique method to gather ingredients for their creation.\nBlacksmiths gathers ore from fields while Alchemist gathers herbs.\nChef acquires cooking ingredients from dead monsters and Artisans randomly obtain ingredients after killing monsters.
3100000011: You can check the current quest's target location on the world map(Hotkey M). \nClick on the world map's quest list to find a target's location.
3100000012: "After completing the guardian quest,\nyou can summon a guardian of your profession when the guardian gage on your character information window is full.\nSummon and check out your guardian's awesome powers."
3100000013: You can aquire profession exp when you create profession-unique items or gather ingredients for created items.
3100000014: You can register social action and emoticon commands in any hotkey window from the social information window(Hotkey K).
3100000015: You can create items for other people using your personal storefont (Hotkey Y) if you have the item creation skill.\nIngredients for the created item must be handed to the creator by the purchaser.
3100000016: "For creation items that cannot be created with your profession,\nit is a good idea to shop other players' personal stores or bid for items at the Auction House."
3100000017: You can proceed with the Guardian quest through Prontera's profession NPC when you reach profession level 10.\nYou acquire the right to summon a guardian upon completion.
3100000018: "When you press the window icon in the upper right corner of the world map, the screen changes to simple map that shows the map image in the center of the screen.\nYou can control the transparency of the simple map by moving the transparency bar while holding down the Ctrl key on the simple map."
3100000019: You can whisper to others that you whispered to recently by using the Backspace key in the chat window.\nUse the Tab key if you want to whisper to people you whispered previously.
3100000020: "You can easily type past chatting contents but using the ↑, ↓ keys in the chat window."
3100000021: "Enjoy 10-person raid dungeons, only for level 50 players!\nExperience the Arena Dungeon, located east of Prontera City, and Baphomet's Garden, located deep within Brownie Forest in East Mt. Mjolnir!"
3100000022: "You can move to the location you want more quickly if you use Kafra Flight Services, located at the entrance of each village or city."
3100000023: "You must wait for other players that are completing the same quest to finish it and proceed with certain escort, protection and accompaniment quests."
3100000024: Try long distance Flight Services between cities.\nGo talk to Kafra Serena in the front of the Prontera Fountain or Kafra Richael of Alberta in the Merchant District!
3100000025: The Information Panel on the right side of screen provides simple information of quests and Khara achievements that are in progress.
3100000026: You can easily use a necessary skill until the recommended skill (hotkey F) is displayed in the middle of screen.
3100000027: "By using the mount’s icon from a quick-slot, \n you don’t always need to open mount window (I) to ride on it. \n Also, right-clicking a buff icon will cancel you out of mount mode. "
